sources.title: Beike interview image transcript containing the equal-value linked-list prompt
Answer Batch 0018 mechanically extracted repository-source packet
Deterministic Java validation against nested-loop oracle
Source-first isolated review for the equal-value linked-list candidate

claims.text: The strongest retained repository source states that the two linked lists are unordered, do not intersect structurally, and asks for nodes whose values are equal; it does not specify return shape, duplicate semantics, value type or API.
int values, all matching node pairs, Cartesian duplicate semantics, stable left-then-right index order, null-as-empty and non-mutation are explicit candidate choices rather than source facts.

Indexing every right-list position by value and expanding every indexed position for each left node yields exactly all equal-value node pairs under the candidate all-pairs contract, including duplicates.
With left length n, right length m and k output matches, the implementation runs in O(n+m+k) time, uses O(m) auxiliary indexing space, and returns O(k) output.
The exact Java fixture passes 7 fixed cases and 5000 deterministic randomized list pairs against a nested-loop oracle, including duplicate Cartesian semantics and stable left-then-right result order.
